scope: Reusable development/research process; project facts and credentials do not transfer automatically.
memory_boundary: External context/checkpoint layer only. Must be loaded; does not alter weights or guarantee automatic future recall.
user_preference: Use available connected GitHub/GitLab/Google and other task-relevant sources; avoid making the user restate already verified project decisions.

authorization.current_task: User requested restoring XRBC homepage shown in screenshot; bounded CSS repair merged via standard MR !10.
rules: Verify access each session; stop for missing permissions/approval.
No unrelated accounts, credential extraction, live financial actions or deployment/configuration changes merely to audit.
Public repository memory must not contain secrets/private personal records.

github.memory_write: verify containing commit read-back; authorization granted for this task

gitlab.write: Verified standard MR !9 and !10 merges; no protection bypass.

google.status: user permits relevant use; not probed

other_services.status: discover and verify only as needed

repair_workflow: read bootstrap/current issue and exact source
review CI findings not badge only
research_workflow: retrieve current authoritative sources when required
publication_rules: Publish related memory pointers atomically when possible.
Never force-push or bypass protected workflow.
Validate JSON, pointers, graph references and issue routing.
Read back committed bytes before claiming completion.
model_independence: Do not infer entitlement/capability or defect authorship from historical model labels. Evidence standards apply at every tier.
responsive_layout_checks: Preserve the saved reference layout while repairing visibility. Trade/Liquidity use a fixed left rail above 900px; never move one to a top header at desktop widths without user direction.
Identify exact page from screenshot and source; distinguish XRBC homepage from XRBitcoin.
Move complete position/inset/height/display/navigation/content-offset resets together when changing a breakpoint.
Check screenshot width and widths immediately below/above old and new breakpoints.
Account for selector specificity and refresh CSS cache key.
Label source cascade, rendered geometry, served build and live wallet checks separately.
